couriers.label: Couriers: default courier
couriers.help: The courier a booking offers first, and the one listed first in Couriers. Left empty, the first courier is the default.

payouts.label: Couriers: payouts through the courier's own payment request
payouts.help: Off as shipped. When on, a person with the right and the owner's PIN can ask a courier to pay what it holds, through the courier's own payment-request feature. The request is read back by itself; when the courier says Paid, the orders it covers are marked settled. Polling interval in minutes and the smallest amount to ask for are set here.

claimTerms.label: Couriers: time to pay a claim
claimTerms.help: Off as shipped. When on, a claim gets a deadline (the days set here) when it is raised, a claim past it is flagged late, and one close to it is flagged due soon. The last switch posts money won back from a courier to its account; keep it off until the owner has said yes.
